uncertainty_coverage.terminology: empirical uncertainty interval under estimator (not calibrated Bayesian credible interval)
uncertainty_coverage.notes: 100% monotonic ordering is guaranteed by mathematical construction; true empirical coverage verifies actual inclusion of unseen true future horizon.

future_leakage.conclusion: Estimator is strictly causal; evaluations at t <= t_cutoff are bitwise invariant to future observations.

transient_recovery.conclusion: Transient fault elevates D(t) during active duration, transitions to NON_DEGRADING upon clearing, and fully stabilizes after window duration has elapsed.
